research_question: Against the corrected personal-tradability V3 baseline, which of the already established 30-day stability family and 40-day standout challenger retains non-degradation without changing buy identity?

data_contract.personal_filter: new_retail_cash_account; main-board A shares only; PIT unadjusted close <= 200 CNY; current static name/status not backfilled
data_contract.entry_identity_rule: preserve every personal-baseline signal day, actual symbol and strategy rank including affordable replacements
data_contract.sizing_rule: use unchanged V3 current-NAV sizing, board-lot rounding and concentration cap
data_contract.event_role: official events are a negative conflict gate only; positive events cannot create or extend a position
data_contract.liquidity_priority: core ordinary positions are protected; externally deferred positions are recalled to fund V3 entries

boundary.entry_set: exact frozen personal-V3 executed-buy identity set

model.target: deferred-exit close return minus frozen mechanical-exit close return
model.target_availability: deferred label joins only after its exit day is strictly before the current decision
model.core_features: position path, rank and V3 entry price-volume features
model.full_features: core plus PIT global, SW L1, macro and official-event features
model.external_increment: full ridge prediction minus core ridge prediction

selection.selection_rule: among tuning-and-validation passers choose the smallest horizon within one validation standard error of the best
selection.standout_gate: at least 10 percent relative return improvement, or one fewer negative month together with improved drawdown
selection.robustness_requirement: formal pass still requires trigger concentration, leave-one-trigger-out and an untouched forward account window
